rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not default unknown to false or normal; stop and request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Routine HPV screening is not recommended. Symptoms and established follow-up pathways override this age gate.
rules.source_document: NCSP June 2023 v1.1
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: Participant under 25 already in screening or follow-up
rules.required_facts: Date of birth; prior result; next indicated appointment
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not default unknown to false or normal; stop and request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Recall at the next clinically indicated appointment rather than applying a new routine-screening interval.
rules.source_document: NCSP June 2023 v1.1
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: Participant under 25 with early sexual activity, sexual abuse history, symptoms, or another clinical concern
rules.required_facts: Age; symptoms; relevant clinical history; safeguarding context
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not default unknown to false or normal; stop and request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Do not automatically initiate routine screening. Require clinician review and apply symptom, safeguarding, or specialist pathways as appropriate.
rules.source_document: NCSP June 2023 v1.1
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: Type 3 TZ + HPV positive + low-grade cytology + normal colposcopy
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not issue a confident terminal outcome when any required fact is unknown; request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: MDM cytology review not required before observation
rules.source_document: NCSP guideline addendum v1.0 (2 Feb 2026) + June 2023 base
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: CIN2 on biopsy, age <30, Type 1/2 TZ, no CIN3/invasion
rules.required_facts: Age; biopsy; TZ; exclusion of CIN3/invasion; participant preference
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not issue a confident terminal outcome when any required fact is unknown; request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: MDM review. If CIN2 confirmed and participant agrees, active surveillance with colposcopy/cytology every 6 months up to 24 months
rules.source_document: NCSP guideline addendum v1.0 (2 Feb 2026) + June 2023 base
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: Active surveillance: biopsy downgraded to LSIL
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not issue a confident terminal outcome when any required fact is unknown; request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Discharge from colposcopy with HPV +/- cytology in 12 months
rules.source_document: NCSP guideline addendum v1.0 (2 Feb 2026) + June 2023 base
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: Active surveillance: CIN2 regresses
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not issue a confident terminal outcome when any required fact is unknown; request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Discharge from colposcopy with Test of Cure at 12 months
rules.source_document: NCSP guideline addendum v1.0 (2 Feb 2026) + June 2023 base
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: Active surveillance: CIN3 diagnosed at any follow-up or CIN2 persists at 24 months
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not issue a confident terminal outcome when any required fact is unknown; request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Treatment recommended
rules.source_document: NCSP guideline addendum v1.0 (2 Feb 2026) + June 2023 base
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: Positive HSIL excision margins, age <50
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not issue a confident terminal outcome when any required fact is unknown; request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Test of Cure can be in primary/community care
rules.source_document: NCSP guideline addendum v1.0 (2 Feb 2026) + June 2023 base
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: HPV-detected AIS with clear excision margins
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not issue a confident terminal outcome when any required fact is unknown; request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Primary/community co-tests at 6 and 18 months
rules.source_document: NCSP guideline addendum v1.0 (2 Feb 2026) + June 2023 base
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: Stage 1a1 cervical cancer treated by local excision
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not issue a confident terminal outcome when any required fact is unknown; request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Return to regular screening only after successful treatment and ToC; HPV detected or abnormal cytology during ToC -> colposcopy; after completed ToC, HPV detected -> Figure 3
rules.source_document: NCSP guideline addendum v1.0 (2 Feb 2026) + June 2023 base
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: Stage 1a1 cervical cancer treated by total hysterectomy
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not issue a confident terminal outcome when any required fact is unknown; request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Cease screening after completing Test of Cure
rules.source_document: NCSP guideline addendum v1.0 (2 Feb 2026) + June 2023 base
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: Other previous cervical/vaginal cancer
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not issue a confident terminal outcome when any required fact is unknown; request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Outside NCSP screening recommendations; clinician and participant determine testing/management
rules.source_document: NCSP guideline addendum v1.0 (2 Feb 2026) + June 2023 base
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: HSIL without ToC before hysterectomy for non-cervical gynaecological cancer
rules.required_facts: Prior HSIL; hysterectomy indication; ToC status
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not issue a confident terminal outcome when any required fact is unknown; request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Undertake ToC; cease after two HPV-not-detected/negative-cytology co-tests 12 months apart
rules.source_document: NCSP guideline addendum v1.0 (2 Feb 2026) + June 2023 base
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: Gynaecological cancer + subtotal hysterectomy
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not issue a confident terminal outcome when any required fact is unknown; request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Continue cervical screening and register notifications
rules.source_document: NCSP guideline addendum v1.0 (2 Feb 2026) + June 2023 base
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: CIN2 remains under surveillance before 24 months
rules.required_facts: Follow-up histology/cytology/colposcopy; surveillance duration; MDM review date
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not default unknown to false or normal; stop and request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Complete a follow-up MDM review before the 24-month endpoint and document the revised plan.
rules.source_document: NCSP guideline addendum v1.0 (2 Feb 2026)
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: Participant requests treatment at any surveillance event while CIN2 remains
rules.required_facts: Participant preference; current CIN2 status; fertility/pregnancy considerations; clinician plan
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not default unknown to false or normal; stop and request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Offer clinician-led treatment planning without requiring surveillance to continue to 24 months.
rules.source_document: NCSP guideline addendum v1.0 (2 Feb 2026)
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.

rules.condition: Immune-deficiency status is assigned or changed
rules.required_facts: Classifier; date; source condition/medication; threshold/duration; rationale for “highly considered”; specialist input; laboratory-request flag
rules.missing_data_behavior: Do not default unknown to false or normal; stop and request information or require clinician review.
rules.provisional_outcome: Store the provenance and record whether immune-deficient status was indicated on the laboratory request. Unknown or unlisted combinations require clinician review.
rules.source_document: NCSP immune-deficiency guidance v1.0.1, 12 Mar 2026
rules.implementation_note: Provisional recommendation only; reviewer confirmation required; not for direct clinical action.
